leftEvidence.title: The poor in spirit receive the Kingdom

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus calls the poor in spirit blessed.
points.right: Jesus stands on a level place among disciples and a crowd, heals, and addresses the poor, hungry, weeping, and rejected.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: The Kingdom of Heaven is said to be theirs in the present tense.
points.right: Four blessings are followed by four woes directed to the rich, full, laughing, and well-spoken-of.

payload.posture: Matthew and Luke open corresponding blessing sequences with materially different wording.

rightEvidence.title: Luke places blessings and woes on a level place

payload.tension: Matthew adds “in spirit”; Luke directly addresses the poor and later speaks woes to the rich.
payload.title: Poor in spirit and poor
